speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you have an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node, which is a significant finding. Can you describe the nature of your abdominal pain and how long you have experienced these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the pain localize to a specific area, such as the lower left quadrant, and have you experienced any changes in your bowel habits like diarrhea or constipation? I also need to know if you have any personal or family history of inflammatory bowel disease or recent travel to endemic areas.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any fever, itching, or pain in the swollen node after drinking alcohol? I also need to know if you have noticed any other swollen lymph nodes in your armpits or groin.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.
